description: AgentShield security evidence, harness permissions, deadlock audit, and safety guardrails

securityPillars.enforcement: Blocks destructive git operations: push origin, push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd, branch -D, restore, checkout on paths, commit --no-verify, and gh pr merge --admin
Prevents webview deadlock and unresponsive surfaces by verifying window creation, event listeners, and mutex handling in src-tauri
Blocks forbidden paths (target/, .superpowers/, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/worktrees/, config.json, *.log) and whitespace errors
All external MCP servers (github, context7, exa, memory, playwright, sequential-thinking) disabled by default. Credentials forbidden from repo commits.
